name: bibtex-reference-manager-mcp
description: BibTeX reference manager MCP server for AI apps. Parse, convert, dedupe and lint BibTeX, RIS and CSL JSON reference lists and make cite keys. Works offline, no account.

tools.name: parse_bibliography
tools.description: Read BibTeX, RIS or CSL JSON text and return normalized entries.

tools.name: convert_bibliography
tools.description: Convert between BibTeX, RIS, CSL JSON and plain text.

tools.name: dedupe_entries
tools.description: Find duplicate references by DOI, title similarity and cite key.

tools.name: lint_entries
tools.description: Flag missing fields, bad page ranges, uncapitalized titles and invalid DOIs.

tools.name: generate_cite_keys
tools.description: Create consistent cite keys like smith2024deep.
